heard: Astronauts floating in orbit are actually not beyond Earth's gravity. While many believe space is a complete zero gravity vacuum, the everyday reality is quite different. At the soaring altitude of the space station, Earth's gravitational field is still nearly 90% as strong as on the ground. Human space travelers do not float because gravity has vanished entirely from their location. Instead, they stay up because they are caught in a continuous state of perpetual freefall. Their immense horizontal speed continually carries them around the curving horizon of our home planet. That precise physics mechanism is why astronauts floating in orbit are actually not beyond Earth's gravity.
